summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.88/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.88 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 22, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 3¢ higher than a week ago, 16¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.06 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.60) and the highest in Superior ($4.25).
